content:
maria_cs: Hey team — quick heads up on Bamboo Inc. onboarding. Their chat endpoint p50 ~230ms but p95 spikes to ~1.2s after 10am PST. Renewal in 45 days and finance is sensitive to unit cost. I did a lightweight run of the eval prompts and saw token cost variance on longer contexts. Looking for actionable, low-risk recs: quantization plan, model swap for non-critical traffic, and routing split suggestions. @raj_infra can you validate feasibility?

raj_infra: Got it. Quick Qs: what model + instance are they on in prod? Also what's typical seq len distribution? Need that to estimate KV cache benefits vs quantization.

maria_cs: Prod is `redwood/rdx-medium-6B` on fp16, routed to us-west. Seq len avg 128, 95th ~512. Sample log excerpt below:```
[2026-03-19T17:02:12Z] req_id=abc123 model=rdx-medium-6B lat_p95=1.18s tokens=412 cost=$0.028
[2026-03-19T17:02:13Z] req_id=abc124 model=rdx-medium-6B lat_p95=1.24s tokens=489 cost=$0.034
```

lucy_se: Couple of ideas: 1) Int8 quantization (per-model quant profile) usually reduces infer cost ~30-50% and often improves latency due to memory locality. 2) For chat messages with deterministic system prompts, enable prefix/KV cache for the first 128 tokens to avoid re-compute. 3) Route low-priority traffic (background generation, summarization jobs) to a smaller 1.3B quantized variant.

kevin_cust: Appreciate this. Our renewals team wants to see at least 30% unit-cost reduction or a clear plan. Quality is critical — we can't accept >1% drop in accuracy for user-facing flows. Happy to trial canary.

emma_product: Recommend staged experiment: 10% traffic -> quantized rdx-medium-6B-int8, 10% -> rdx-small-1.3B-quant, 80% baseline. Monitor generation scorecards (ROUGE/semantic-sim) + latency/cost. If quality delta <1% and cost reduction >=30% on canary window (72h), proceed with 50% ramp.

raj_infra: Technical checklist from infra: 1) Build quantized artifact using our quant pipeline (QProf). 2) Run internal perf test for seq=512 and batch sizes 1/4/8. 3) Set routing rule: `if request.priority == "low" -> rdx-small-1.3B-quant` and fallback to baseline on timeouts. 4) Canary config: `traffic_split: {baseline:80, rdx-int8:10, rdx-small:10}`.

opsbot: DeployBot: Canary slot reserved -> 1958304800. Reminder: create canary eval prompt set under Bamboo/canary-2026-03.

lucy_se: For evals, capture both semantic match and hallucination rate. I can produce a 200-prompt benchmark from their top 10 intents. Also suggest enabling dynamic batching up to 8 for the quantized variant to maximize throughput without hurting p50.

maria_cs: Thanks — action items: @lucy_se to build 200-prompt canary set by EOD, @raj_infra to produce perf numbers and deploy quant artifact to canary slot, @emma_product to configure dashboards and quality alerts, I'll schedule renewal enablement call with Bamboo leadership.

kevin_cust: Sounds good. We can provide a few production prompts for the benchmark. Also want a one-pager we can show procurement summarizing expected cost savings and rollback plan.

maria_cs: Will prepare one-pager (cost delta, quality guardrails, rollback steps). Proposed cadence: run 72h canary starting 1958304800, then review metrics and decide ramp. Meeting: Wed 10am PST for results review.

emma_product: I'll add automated regression alerts: alert if quality_drop > 0.75% OR latency_p95 increases by >15%.

raj_infra: One more infra note — if quantization causes tokenization drift, we'll auto-fallback on content mismatch; add `content_hash` guard in routing policy.

maria_cs: Great. Thanks everyone — keeping this thread as the single source for owners and logs. I'll post the meeting invite and attach the one-pager draft. :thumbsup:

kevin_cust: Appreciate the proactive approach. Looking forward to the canary results.
